title: Check yourself: Compaction, crash recovery and the practice

questions.stem: Scenario S4, developer productivity with Claude. During a long exploration the team wants automatic summarising near the limit to keep the roster of sources already opened and the commands that run the tests. What should they do?

options.text: Turn automatic summarising off so that nothing is condensed at all
options.says: Ruled out because "Turning compaction off is not a remedy: the window then fills, and performance degrades".

options.text: Add a sentence on what to preserve to the project's instructions file
options.says: A standing instruction in the project's file steers the automatic summary toward what the exploration needs.

options.text: Raise the output limit so that the summary can run longer than usual
options.says: Ruled out because "Left to itself the summary keeps what looks important", and a longer summary still chooses by that.

options.text: Clear the conversation at each phase so that nothing needs preserving
options.says: Ruled out because clearing "starts over and is right between unrelated tasks", and a phase of the same exploration is not one.

questions.stem: Scenario S4, developer productivity with Claude. A coordinator restarts after a crash. Its manifest lists 6 agents as running, and notes written by only 4 of them can be found on disk. What should it do?

options.text: Restart the whole set, since a manifest written before a crash cannot be trusted
options.says: Ruled out because for an agent whose file survived, "the file is there, so the work is kept".

options.text: Resume each of the 6 on the manifest's word, giving empty notes to the 2 without any
options.says: Ruled out because for a missing file there is "nothing to continue from, whatever the manifest says".

options.text: Replay the 6 transcripts into the new coordinator before it continues
options.says: Ruled out because "the transcripts are what filled the window".

options.text: Carry on from the saved material where it exists and begin afresh where it does not
options.says: The agents with files continue from them and the others start over, since the file outranks the status.
